text.text_excerpt: Ah water ice. I am a lover of all things cold and fruity: slushes, snowballs, popsicles, everything. Water ice may take the top spot. I buy the little italian ice cups in the store but Tapeh's is much better. I get to choose up to 3 different flavors to swirl. They have like 20 flavors to choose from! I'm partial to the strawberry lemonade and the pineapple but I try to switch it up each time. The flavor is through and through and the ice is smoother than Michael Jackson's moonwalk. The service is always good. There's a small parking lot, which is a plus. AND they have food. I got the chicken strips (because I'm 10) before and really enjoyed them. Definitely worth the drive to the westban...

The water ice is phenomenal! It's so flavorful. The texture elevates it even more. Definitely stop for a taste. Also, they have hand cut fries!!! Water ice and hand cut fries make for a good day! They also have a full menu of food. I had a shrimp poboy once which left something to be desired. But don't go there for poboys. Lol They also have an amazing lunch special. You can get 3 items for $6. That's amazing deal. They also have funnel cakes and fried Oreos!

I've been twice already since they've opened and I'm a happy customer each time. I've had water ice- think airier sorbet -from the street in New York and Chicago and always wished that there was a way I could get my hands on some in New Orleans. I was ecstatic to hear of Tapeh's opening. On the first trip I got the small water ice with mango and piña colada flavors with ice cream on top plus an order of funnel fries, like a funnel cake, but in the shape of fries. The second time, I got a small strawberry lemonade. YUM! There's been a line of customers each time, but it moves quickly. They've had a line both times, but it moves quickly.
